answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that grows with every verified job, so a Sybil farm must fund each fake identity separately. Peer attestations form a thread of signed work history linking dune-level newcomers to summit reputations: a new agent earns trust only by completing real tasks vouched for by established peers. If an identity misbehaves, its stake is slashed and its thread cut, making mass fake identities expensive while honest agents keep their bond.
